elements.p: Wavebreak keeps its own hours. Up at six, the shops and stalls open, work until five. Then the tavern, the chess boards, the easels and the long walk home. Everyone is abed by half past ten, except the Night Watch.
When it rains the outdoor folk crowd into the inn and the Grog Barrel. Ginny Tallow the lamplighter and the Watch carry on regardless.
Ginny walks her round at dusk and lights the street lamps one by one. They go out again by morning.
Every third morning the bell calls the town to service: Father Anselm preaches, Harmonia plays the organ and the choir sings.

elements.row: Market day - every 7th day: a stall and Marco Venn
Music night - every other evening: Fiddler Dan plays
Festival - every 8th evening: lanterns and dancing

elements.p: The town's sweethearts are married one at a time, with the organ, vows, bells and fireworks. Two captains may ask Father Anselm to marry them any day: stand at the altar together.
Kill one of the great beasts and the town throws you a party the next evening.
If you die at sea your name goes on the memorial roll, and the chapel holds a service for you the next morning.
Once every fortnight or so the town gives a day over to something special, and never two on the same day. The crier calls them out, and the Chess League board counts down to the next tournament.

Every game of chess counts toward a player's rating. On tournament day the four best players play two semi-finals and a final on the Chess Green, and the winner is champion. Sign up at the League board to play in it.
The biggest fish by sundown wins the Golden Marlin. Cast anywhere round the island: every fish is weighed as it comes in. Finn and his friends fish off the quay all day, and they are hard to beat.

The farmers bring their best to the chapel, and Father Anselm will take your gift of food too. At dusk there's a feast for the whole town at long tables in the Bazaar. Everyone eats, and those who gave get a blessing.
There's a waltz in the Residence ballroom and a toast from the Governor. Captains in good standing with the Armada get an invitation that morning. The guards turn away anyone without one.

The town's three boats race side by side out to the turning buoy and back to the line, and the whole town cheers from the quay. Have your own ship near the start at five o'clock and you race too. There's a purse for the first three home.
Sometimes a battered merchantman limps in, smoking, and the town runs to help. Dr Marrow will be glad of any Sea Bandages you bring, and her captain pays well for them.
Some evenings a visiting ship anchors off the harbour mouth, and her sailors drink the Grog Barrel dry.
The den at the back has Liar's Dice, Crown and Anchor, and the roulette wheel. The regulars are happy to take a seat, and they remember who beat them.

Use the board to start a game of 301 and a regular will take you on. Three darts a turn, thrown from three paces back. Finish on exactly 0: go under and it's a bust. Brannoc and Lazlo almost never miss.
There's a small table in the toymaker's shop and a giant board on the Green. Play a friend, play the computer, or ask any townsperson who plays for a game.
Beat Commodore Pettigrew and he'll give you his trophy, though he'll want a rematch.
Paint whatever you like on an easel in any colour, then finish it on a Blank Canvas to make a painting you can hang. Isadora Vane will buy a good one for her gallery.
Your beard grows while you sail: stubble, then a short beard, then a long one. Snip will trim it into any of twelve styles and dye it if you like.

Inka Rook inks forearms, chest and back from her flash sheet. The finest designs are earned: the Jolly Roger, the Sea Serpent, the Ghost Ship, the Kraken and the Leviathan, each after its beast is dead.

elements.row: Ships in bottles, for the mantelpiece
